note: Linn County MO's official parcel viewer (linngis.integritygis.com H5, linked from assessorsearch.com) is unreachable from here: every request to that host failed, and no ArcGIS REST directory for it could be probed. Searches of integritygis public services, MSDIS and gis.mo.gov statewide listings found no Linn County parcel polygon layer. The assessor's GIS mapping is behind a paid subscription tier. Only commercial vendors (Regrid, Dynamo, Acres, Rockford, Equator) publish Linn parcels.
